title: A Clark-Ocone formula in UMD Banach spaces
authors: Jan Maas and Jan van Neerven
version: arXiv:0709.2021v2, primary author manuscript; journal ECP 13 (2008), 151–164
review: Direct primary text: Sections 3–4 derivative/divergence definitions and displayed proofs, and Theorems 6.6–6.7 complete statements and displayed proofs (PDF index 9). General UMD Ito construction prerequisites are not fully re-audited. Comparison credits classical value-space stochastic integration, density and bounded extension. No external theorem is imported as a new axiom.
limits: Bounded targeted search for IBM Ito/number regularization and vector-valued Malliavin recovery does not certify novelty for this exact reflected-scenery family/limit topology. Specific priority unresolved; no new general Gaussian or Clark-Ocone calculus claim.
